adjudication.rationale: Looking at the Office365 CalendarService.ts diff, the code extracts `[mainHostDestinationCalendar]` from `event.destinationCalendar ?? []` and uses it to construct the eventsUrl. This always selects the first destination calendar regardless of which credential is being used. In contrast, the GoogleCalendarService.ts diff shows the correct pattern: it receives `credentialId` as a parameter and uses `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` to select the matching calendar. The Office365 implementation doesn't receive or use credentialId to match the correct destination calendar, meaning when multiple hosts have different destination calendars, all credentials would write to the first (organizer's) calendar ID instead of their own.
